name: Video Toolkit
description: 21 video tools in one place: convert between MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI and WebM, make GIFs, extract audio, compress (or compress to a size for Discord/WhatsApp), trim, crop, resize, rotate, change speed, reverse, loop, merge, watermark, add music, remove green screen and cut Reels/Shorts. Runs locally on FFmpeg.
author: WebDeck
